arguments.prompt:
Create a professional native pixel-art combat animation SOURCE ATLAS of Gray Fox, EXACT selected incarnation: Metal Gear Solid (1998), Gray Fox in the Cyborg Ninja exoskeleton.

APPEARANCE AND EQUIPMENT: Enclosed blue-grey and orange Cyborg Ninja suit with red central eye sensor, physical straight katana. No exposed damaged body or Raiden costume.

Adult character, nonsexual practical game presentation. Recognizable clean detailed 16-bit sprites. All figures face screen-right in a coherent three-quarter side view. Same character design, body proportions and anatomical scale in all cells; crouching is naturally shorter. All full bodies and all equipment completely inside their cells, with generous empty transparent margins.

STRICT LAYOUT: exactly FORTY-EIGHT separate complete figures, EIGHT COLUMNS by SIX ROWS (8 x 6 regular grid). TRANSPARENT background. No labels, numbers, text, grid lines, panels, floor, cast shadow, scenery or other people. Every successive group of four pictures is a genuine FOUR-FRAME sequence with four independently drawn DIFFERENT poses; never duplicate complete figures.

ROW 1, columns 1-4 INTRO: calmly enter readiness with equipment held safely without attacking; columns 5-8 OUTRO: lower equipment/hands, slight turn, step or shift to leave, settle. No firing in either sequence.

ROW 2, columns 1-4 ROUND VICTORY: a restrained individual acknowledgment with equipment held safely without attacking; columns 5-8 ROUND DEFEAT: catch breath or settle mechanical balance, stoop slightly, steady, recover. No firing.

ROW 3, columns 1-4 FINISHING PRESENTATION: one physical straight katana cut with the blade kept complete: ready, step, controlled slash, recover; no energy wave; columns 5-8 MATCH VICTORY: a distinctive calm personal recognition gesture and settle, visibly different from round victory. No firing in victory.

ROW 4, columns 1-4 MATCH DEFEAT: slowly crouch or lower posture, bow head or settle shoulders, regain balance, settle; no injury; columns 5-8 SUPER: a separate newly drawn sequence of one physical straight katana cut with the blade kept complete: ready, step, controlled slash, recover; no energy wave, different drawings from the finishing presentation.

ROW 5, columns 1-4 IDLE: four subtle breathing or mechanism/weight-transfer poses with equipment held safely without attacking; columns 5-8 RUN: four natural full locomotion-cycle poses with equipment retained safely.

ROW 6, columns 1-4 ORDINARY ACTION: one physical straight katana cut with the blade kept complete: ready, step, controlled slash, recover; no energy wave, separate new drawings from super; columns 5-8 HIT REACTION: non-graphic recoil, protective posture, recover balance, settle.

Solo non-graphic animation acting only. No victim, opponent, blood, wounds, severing, corpse or death spectacle. Quiet intro/outro/victory/defeat/idle/run/hit rows never attack, fire, emit offensive effects or invent abilities. Preserve source anatomy, costume, weapon, blade colour/count and exact 48-figure 8-by-6 layout. No generalized aura, body glow, unrelated tool or borrowed power.
